<title level="1" right="Spell 7" pfs="Standard">
[Execute](/Spells.aspx?ID=1519)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Death" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=40" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Void" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=510" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 329

**Traditions**
[Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
[basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude

</row>

</column>

---

You point at a creature and invoke the demise of all things. The target takes 70 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. If the target is [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) or otherwise has [void healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=42), the spell loses the [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) and [void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510) traits and gains the [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509) trait, and the target takes 70 vitality damage with a basic Fortitude save.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 10.
name: Execute
